skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The outfit this Operator wears most often.
While not as practical as a uniform, it's what they find most comfortable.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
An outfit that has been improved after the Operator's Promotion.
Custom-made to suit each Operator's experiences and needs, these outfits are designed to provide them maximum flexibility on any battlefield. Furthermore, this is all done without compromising the comfort that they've come to expect.

skins.name: Light and Shadow
skins.content: EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/Light and Shadow. A trendy, vintage Victorian appeal, modified to Nightmare's specifications. Some decorative elements will change when Nightmare's personality shifts.
skins.quote: The time has suddenly come, reversing black and white.

skins.name: The Ferry Girl
skins.content: Unveiling of Devotion Series New Arrivals/The Ferry Girl. Clothes Gloria wears on outings. The pink and white of the dress and the flowers complement each other. This is the ferry to the land of love, and she's waiting for you to board.
skins.quote: 'My dear, how can the land of love be real when these lands are so full of hardship? Love and loss walk hand in hand. Do you understand now? This ferry is the final stop. Alright then, now close your eyes, and sleep tight.'
